get_device: get the currently available device type returning cuda, npu, mlu, mps, or cpu
get_max_cuda_memory: get the maximum GPU memory allocated in megabytes for a given cuda device
is_cuda_available: check if cuda devices are available on the current system
is_npu_available: check if Ascend NPU devices are available on the current system
is_mps_available: check if MPS devices for Mac M1 chips are available on the system
